overview.zh: 故障恢复先读取当前状态并展示故障摘要，用户确认后发送 RESET；系统回到 UNCONTROLLABLE 后需要重新 ENABLE。UNKNOWN 多圈位置必须另行恢复，Rope Init 是单独的参考初始化操作。
overview.en: Fault recovery reads current state and shows a summary, then sends RESET only after confirmation; the system returns to UNCONTROLLABLE and requires ENABLE again. UNKNOWN multi-turn positions need separate recovery, and Rope Init is a distinct reference-initialization action.

zh.plain: Clear Fault 会读取当前 P4 状态、生成活动故障摘要、展示确认对话框；确认后调用 RESET，并把系统带回 UNCONTROLLABLE，用户仍需重新 ENABLE。
zh.condition: 入口由 Replay UI 状态或用户确认触发，详细控制顺序见该函数源码。
zh.effect: 发现 UNKNOWN 多圈位置时，在确认对话框加入 turn-recovery guide；取消时不调用 reset。
zh.failure: 先消除故障原因；对 UNKNOWN 电机完成 turn recovery/重新标定，再确认清故障。
zh.recovery: 故障确认、RESET、Rope Init 是不同操作阶段。
zh.unknown: When UNKNOWN multi-turn positions exist, the confirmation includes a turn-recovery guide; canceling does not call reset.
zh.difference: Resolve the cause first; recover or recalibrate UNKNOWN motors before confirming fault clear.
zh.change: Fault confirmation, RESET, and Rope Init are distinct stages.

en.plain: Clear Fault reads current P4 state, builds active-fault details, asks for confirmation, then sends RESET to return to UNCONTROLLABLE; the user must ENABLE again.
en.condition: Entered from Replay UI state or user confirmation; see the function source for ordering.
en.effect: 故障原因仍激活时清除后可能再次出现；RESET 不代表位置参考自动恢复。
en.failure: 静态代码说明确认和请求路径，不证明硬件故障已消除或 RESET 被 P4 接受。
en.recovery: 基线未标记该流程为变更。
en.unknown: A still-active cause can recur after clearing; RESET does not automatically restore position references.
en.difference: The source shows confirmation and request flow, not that a hardware fault is gone or P4 accepted RESET.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this workflow as changed.

zh.plain: clear_fault_with_confirm 构造故障摘要和确认文本，必要时追加 multi-turn UNKNOWN 恢复指南；只有用户接受后才执行 reset。
zh.condition: 源码判断：`state is None`；`callable(builder) and state is not None`；`summary and summary.get("active")`；`not confirmed`；`callable(notifier)`；`callable(body_builder)`；`unknown_mask != 0 or (fault_bitmap & SYSTEM_FAULT_MULTITURN_UNKNOWN) != 0`。表达式逐项决定此节点是否继续。
zh.effect: 先取 state，尝试 _build_fault_summary；显示可滚动确认框；confirmed 后调用 reset_controller，并通知 root。
zh.failure: 查看故障详情和 UNKNOWN mask，先解决物理原因，再确认清除。
zh.recovery: 确认对话框是用户意图门槛；后端 RESET 是随后单独的命令。
zh.unknown: It reads state, tries _build_fault_summary, shows a scrollable confirmation, then calls reset_controller and notifies the root only if confirmed.
zh.difference: Review details and UNKNOWN mask, resolve the physical cause, then confirm clearing.
zh.change: The dialog is a user-intent gate; backend RESET is a separate command afterward.

en.plain: clear_fault_with_confirm builds fault details and confirmation text, adds a multi-turn UNKNOWN guide when needed, and resets only after user acceptance.
en.condition: Source predicates: `state is None`; `callable(builder) and state is not None`; `summary and summary.get("active")`; `not confirmed`; `callable(notifier)`; `callable(body_builder)`; `unknown_mask != 0 or (fault_bitmap & SYSTEM_FAULT_MULTITURN_UNKNOWN) != 0`. Each expression determines whether this node continues.
en.effect: state/summary 缺失时使用通用确认文案；用户取消时设置 cancelled 状态且不 reset。
en.failure: reset_controller 会关闭 ROS2 输出并取消 Replay；此函数不保证 P4 故障原因已消失。
en.recovery: 基线未标记该 handler 为变更。
en.unknown: Missing state/summary uses generic confirmation text; cancel sets a cancelled status without reset.
en.difference: reset_controller disables ROS2 output and cancels Replay; this handler cannot ensure the P4 fault cause is gone.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this handler as changed.

zh.plain: 若本地状态快照为空，handler 尝试通过 context.get_state 补取；失败后仍可显示通用确认。
zh.condition: 源码判断：`state is None`。表达式逐项决定此节点是否继续。
zh.effect: 有 state 才能生成具体 fault summary 和 UNKNOWN mask。
zh.failure: 条件为真时没有 state，使用通用确认；为假时可构造故障摘要。
zh.recovery: 这是详情读取的降级路径，不是 RESET 命令结果。
zh.unknown: With state available, the handler can build a specific fault summary and UNKNOWN mask.
zh.difference: Restore state synchronization and reopen fault details.
zh.change: This is a fallback for detail retrieval, not a RESET result.

en.plain: If the local state snapshot is empty, the handler tries context.get_state; on failure it can still show generic confirmation.
en.condition: Source predicates: `state is None`. Each expression determines whether this node continues.
en.effect: 状态不可用会减少对话框细节，但不自动证明设备无故障。
en.failure: When true, state is missing and generic confirmation is used; when false, build the fault summary.
en.recovery: 基线未标记该守卫为变更。
en.unknown: Missing state reduces dialog detail; it does not prove the device is fault-free.
en.difference: The exception is caught and state remains empty; this branch does not identify the device cause.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this guard as changed.

zh.plain: 只有 root 提供可调用的 _build_fault_summary 且 state 有值时，才尝试生成结构化故障摘要。
zh.condition: 源码判断：`callable(builder) and state is not None`。表达式逐项决定此节点是否继续。
zh.effect: builder(state) 返回当前活动故障、bitmap 与摘要行。
zh.failure: 条件为真时用 builder(state) 生成摘要；为假时跳过结构化摘要。
zh.recovery: 是否有摘要影响对话框内容，不改变用户仍需确认的事实。
zh.unknown: builder(state) returns active-fault status, bitmap, and summary lines.
zh.difference: Check root construction and state snapshot availability.
zh.change: The summary changes dialog detail but not the confirmation requirement.

en.plain: A structured fault summary is attempted only when root has a callable _build_fault_summary and state exists.
en.condition: Source predicates: `callable(builder) and state is not None`. Each expression determines whether this node continues.
en.effect: builder 抛异常时 summary 保持 None，流程改用通用确认文本。
en.failure: When true, build a summary from state; when false, skip structured summary.
en.recovery: 基线未标记该守卫为变更。
en.unknown: If it raises, summary remains None and the flow uses generic confirmation text.
en.difference: Builder exceptions are caught; details are not shown here.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this guard as changed.

zh.plain: summary.active 为真表示当前故障仍活动，确认文本会警告清除后 P4 回到 UNCONTROLLABLE，需再 ENABLE。
zh.condition: 源码判断：`summary and summary.get("active")`。表达式逐项决定此节点是否继续。
zh.effect: 活动 summary 还可展示 bitmap 和 turn UNKNOWN 恢复指导。
zh.failure: 条件为真时显示仍活动的故障细节；为假时显示一般清故障确认。
zh.recovery: 活动故障采用 warning 对话框；无活动摘要用一般 question。
zh.unknown: An active summary can show bitmap and turn-UNKNOWN recovery guidance.
zh.difference: Resolve the listed cause and UNKNOWN positions before confirming.
zh.change: Active faults use a warning dialog; no active summary uses a general question.

en.plain: summary.active true means a fault remains active; the dialog warns that clearing returns P4 to UNCONTROLLABLE and requires ENABLE again.
en.condition: Source predicates: `summary and summary.get("active")`. Each expression determines whether this node continues.
en.effect: 故障未解除时 RESET 后同一条件可能再次触发；确认不是原因已消失的证明。
en.failure: When true, show details for an active fault; when false, show general clear-fault confirmation.
en.recovery: 基线未标记该分支为变更。
en.unknown: If the cause remains, RESET may be followed by the same fault; confirmation does not prove the cause is gone.
en.difference: The summary is a software report and cannot alone diagnose mechanical damage.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this branch as changed.

zh.plain: confirmed 为假表示用户在对话框选择 Cancel；安全设计是不发 RESET。
zh.condition: 源码判断：`not confirmed`。表达式逐项决定此节点是否继续。
zh.effect: 函数更新 cancelled 状态并返回。
zh.failure: 条件为真时用户取消，不调用 reset；为假时确认后继续 reset。
zh.recovery: 这是 UI 用户确认门槛，不是固件拒绝码。
zh.unknown: The handler sets a cancelled status and returns.
zh.difference: Inspect the cause, then reopen the dialog and explicitly confirm.
zh.change: This is user confirmation, not a firmware rejection code.

en.plain: confirmed false means the user chose Cancel; the safe behavior is not to send RESET.
en.condition: Source predicates: `not confirmed`. Each expression determines whether this node continues.
en.effect: 取消不会清故障，也不改变 P4 状态。
en.failure: When true, the user cancelled and reset is not called; when false, continue after confirmation.
en.recovery: 基线未标记该守卫为变更。
en.unknown: Cancel does not clear a fault or change P4 state.
en.difference: A cancellation record does not mean the fault was handled.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this guard as changed.

zh.plain: 若 root 有 _on_clear_fault_confirmed 回调，RESET 请求后会通知 root 更新关联 UI。
zh.condition: 源码判断：`callable(notifier)`。表达式逐项决定此节点是否继续。
zh.effect: 回调存在且 callable 才会调用。
zh.failure: 条件为真时调用 root 通知回调；为假时跳过额外 UI 通知。
zh.recovery: 这是桌面 UI 通知钩子，不是清故障本身。
zh.unknown: The callback is invoked only when it exists and is callable.
zh.difference: If the view does not refresh, reread device state and check the action log.
zh.change: It is a host UI hook, not the reset operation itself.

en.plain: If root provides _on_clear_fault_confirmed, the handler notifies the root after the reset request.
en.condition: Source predicates: `callable(notifier)`. Each expression determines whether this node continues.
en.effect: 回调不存在时清故障流程仍已发起，但额外 UI 通知被跳过。
en.failure: When true, call the root notification callback; when false, skip the extra UI notification.
en.recovery: 基线未标记该守卫为变更。
en.unknown: Without it, fault clearing was still requested but the extra UI notification is skipped.
en.difference: This callback does not mean P4 acknowledged RESET.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this guard as changed.

zh.plain: 只有 body text builder 可用时才用定制格式渲染活动故障细节；否则由 summary.lines 拼接。
zh.condition: 源码判断：`callable(body_builder)`。表达式逐项决定此节点是否继续。
zh.effect: 活动故障摘要仍会进入确认对话框。
zh.failure: 条件为真时用 body_builder 格式化故障文字；为假时拼接 summary.lines。
zh.recovery: 这是文本展示兼容分支，不是安全准入分支。
zh.unknown: An active fault summary still appears in the confirmation dialog.
zh.difference: Inspect the summary lines and root formatter registration.
zh.change: This is a display-format fallback, not a safety-admission branch.

en.plain: A custom formatter is used only when body text builder is callable; otherwise summary.lines are joined.
en.condition: Source predicates: `callable(body_builder)`. Each expression determines whether this node continues.
en.effect: 没有 formatter 只影响展示格式，不会跳过确认或改变 RESET 流程。
en.failure: When true, format text with body_builder; when false, join summary.lines.
en.recovery: 基线未标记该守卫为变更。
en.unknown: Missing formatter only changes presentation; it does not skip confirmation or alter RESET flow.
en.difference: This guard does not evaluate whether the fault is cleared.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this guard as changed.

zh.plain: multi_turn_unknown mask 或 SYSTEM_FAULT_MULTITURN_UNKNOWN 位非零时，确认框额外显示转数未知恢复指南。
zh.condition: 源码判断：`unknown_mask != 0 or (fault_bitmap & SYSTEM_FAULT_MULTITURN_UNKNOWN) != 0`。表达式逐项决定此节点是否继续。
zh.effect: guide mask 优先取 state unknown mask，再退到 active scope mask 或全部有效电机。
zh.failure: 条件为真时追加 multi-turn UNKNOWN 恢复指南；为假时不追加此指南。
zh.recovery: 此安全路径会在确认阶段提醒用户独立处理 position recovery。
zh.unknown: The guide mask prefers the state’s unknown mask, then active-scope mask, then all valid motors.
zh.difference: Follow the guide, recover turn count, and recalibrate affected motors before clearing/enabling.
zh.change: This safety path prompts separate position recovery at confirmation time.

en.plain: A nonzero multi-turn unknown mask or SYSTEM_FAULT_MULTITURN_UNKNOWN bit adds a turn-recovery guide to the dialog.
en.condition: Source predicates: `unknown_mask != 0 or (fault_bitmap & SYSTEM_FAULT_MULTITURN_UNKNOWN) != 0`. Each expression determines whether this node continues.
en.effect: 若未知转数未恢复，仅 RESET 清故障不能重建可信绝对位置。
en.failure: When true, append the multi-turn UNKNOWN recovery guide; when false, omit that guide.
en.recovery: 基线未标记该守卫为变更。
en.unknown: If unknown turns are not recovered, clearing the fault alone cannot recreate trusted absolute position.
en.difference: The mask indicates missing position confidence, not the actual multi-turn value.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this guard as changed.

zh.plain: reset_controller 先取消 Replay、撤销 ROS2 output armed，再调用 backend.reset 将控制器复位。
zh.condition: 入口由 Replay UI 状态或用户确认触发，详细控制顺序见该函数源码。
zh.effect: reset 后系统需重新检查状态并 ENABLE；不是继续原目标。
zh.failure: 等待新的 P4 state/ACK，再按正常 ENABLE 和 scope 流程启动。
zh.recovery: 它是命令执行阶段，发生在用户确认之后。
zh.unknown: After reset, the system must inspect new state and ENABLE again; it does not resume the old target.
zh.difference: Wait for fresh P4 state/ACK, then use normal ENABLE and scope checks.
zh.change: This is the command stage after user confirmation.

en.plain: reset_controller cancels Replay, disarms ROS2 output, then calls backend.reset to reset the controller.
en.condition: Entered from Replay UI state or user confirmation; see the function source for ordering.
en.effect: 若 P4 不在线或拒绝 RESET，桌面调用本身不能保证状态改变。
en.failure: 此节点不清除机械根因，也不自动修复 UNKNOWN encoder reference。
en.recovery: 基线未标记该调用为变更。
en.unknown: If P4 is offline or rejects RESET, the host call alone cannot guarantee a state change.
en.difference: This does not remove a mechanical root cause or restore UNKNOWN encoder references.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this call as changed.

zh.plain: rope_init 初始化绳索/电机参考，按 active joint mask 交给 backend/controller；它与一般 RESET 不同。
zh.condition: 入口由 Replay UI 状态或用户确认触发，详细控制顺序见该函数源码。
zh.effect: 只影响传入 mask 对应的 joint 范围，结果要由 P4 rope-init status/反馈确认。
zh.failure: 选对 joint scope，按界面安全提示执行并等待状态确认。
zh.recovery: 这是参考初始化动作，不是故障清除，也不是自动标定结果。
zh.unknown: It applies only to the joint scope in the mask; confirm the result through P4 rope-init status/feedback.
zh.difference: Choose the correct scope, follow on-screen safety instructions, and wait for state confirmation.
zh.change: This initializes a reference; it is neither fault clearing nor automatic calibration.

en.plain: rope_init initializes rope/motor reference using the active joint mask through the backend/controller; it differs from a general RESET.
en.condition: Entered from Replay UI state or user confirmation; see the function source for ordering.
en.effect: mask 不合适、状态不允许或电机/反馈异常可能导致初始化拒绝或不完整。
en.failure: 源码调用不能证明机构处于适合初始化的机械位置。
en.recovery: 基线未标记该操作为变更。
en.unknown: An unsuitable mask, disallowed state, or motor/feedback fault can reject or interrupt initialization.
en.difference: The source call does not prove the mechanism is in a mechanically suitable position.
en.change: The baseline does not mark this operation as changed.
